DECL	{"assumptions":[],"binders":["v"],"id":"NRS_484B_257_1_o1","intentions":[],"laws":["NRS-484B-257-1"],"narrowings":[{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"The point the third place names has no region in a scene: it is written as an observation at which the subject, on the approach carrier and not yet in the junction, has the sight along the crossing way at or above p.intersecting_way_view_distance. 'Nearest the intersection' is not read as a spatial minimum, and the start of the approach for that place is the last observation on the carrier at which that sight fell short of the distance."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"'the through highway' is read as a highway region the junction lies on that the subject's own approach carrier does not lie on. dev.governs records the carrier a sign governs and no atom places a sign at a way's entrance, so the crossing way is identified by the junction and the carrier, not by the sign's position on it."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"The search back from the entry counts the act at its onset — the rising edges of the act since the start of the search's latest run — so an act that already held at the first observation after the end of the search is not counted."}],"operationalizations":[],"residues":[],"surrogate":false}
